messages.subject: Hansen Test Error Message
parts:
Hello, 

I have been using tsDyn for about a year now for my dissertation and never had any trouble. I started a new work on price transmission in the US livestock industry. When I go for Hansen test (setarTest) for one particular equation, I get the error report that "Error in bootHoAr(linear, type) :  task 1 failed - "invalid polynomial coefficient". 

My specific command is: 
Hansen1 <- setarTest(residual.post.cone.diff, m=3, nboot=10, trim=0.15, test="1vs", hpc="foreach")


I tried using different m values, but every time same response is repeated. But this does not occur with (test="2vs3") option. 

I would really appreciate if someone can please help me out. 

Prasanna

Dear Prasanna


The problem should be fixed now, please try the development version and let me know:

library(devtools)
install_github("tsDyn", ref="Dev94", username="MatthieuStigler", subdir="tsDyn")        

For your information, a simple google search gives many good examples of what reproducible example means:
http://adv-r.had.co.nz/Reproducibility.html

Best

Matthieu
